items.q: Psychosis lasting 10 days after severe stress with complete recovery is classified as what?
items.exp: Brief psychotic disorder lasts at least a day and under a month with eventual full return to premorbid function, often stress precipitated. Longer courses move up the duration ladder.
r: Incorrect. Schizophrenia needs six months.
Correct. Brief psychotic disorder under one month.
Incorrect. Delusional disorder needs month plus encapsulated delusions.
Incorrect. Schizophreniform runs one to six months.
items.kp: Ten days then well equals brief psychosis.

items.q: Schizoaffective disorder requires psychosis without mood symptoms for at least how long?
items.exp: Two weeks of delusions or hallucinations in absence of major mood episode prove independent psychosis within an illness otherwise dominated by concurrent mood and psychosis. Without it, diagnosis is mood disorder with psychotic features.
r: Incorrect. That pattern is psychotic mood disorder.
Correct. Two mood free psychotic weeks required.
Incorrect. Six months is schizophrenia duration.
Incorrect. Year is not the criterion.
items.kp: Two lone psychotic weeks make schizoaffective.

items.q: Man convinced his wife is unfaithful, checking phones and following her, otherwise working normally, likely has which delusional type and key risk?
o: Jealous (Othello); risk of violence to partner
items.exp: Delusional jealousy (Othello syndrome) drives surveillance and confrontation with recognised risk of partner violence, needing risk assessment and safeguarding alongside treatment. Function outside belief stays preserved.
r: Incorrect. Erotomania believes another loves the patient.
Correct. Jealous delusion with partner violence risk.
Incorrect. Somatic concerns body disease or infestation.
Incorrect. Grandiosity inflates status or powers.
items.kp: Othello delusion endangers the accused partner.

items.q: Young woman with new psychosis, seizures, autonomic instability and ovarian teratoma suggests which cause?
items.exp: Autoimmune anti NMDA receptor encephalitis mimics first episode psychosis then adds dyskinesias, seizures and dysautonomia, associated with ovarian teratoma in young women; immunotherapy and tumour removal treat it.
r: Incorrect. Primary psychosis lacks this neurological cascade.
Correct. Anti NMDA encephalitis until excluded.
Incorrect. Brief psychosis excludes medical causes first.
Incorrect. Conversion does not cause dysautonomia and seizures.
items.kp: Psychosis plus seizures plus teratoma: autoimmune brain.

items.q: Postpartum psychosis management priority is what?
o: Emergency psychiatric admission, usually mother and baby unit, treating as bipolar spectrum
items.exp: Postpartum psychosis (about 1 to 2 per 1000 births) is a psychiatric emergency with infanticide and suicide risk, usually bipolar spectrum, needing urgent admission (specialist mother baby unit where available), antipsychotics, mood treatment and safeguarding. Baby blues are mild and self limiting by contrast.
r: Incorrect. Blues are tearful mild days, not psychosis.
Correct. Emergency admission and bipolar spectrum treatment.
Incorrect. Home antidepressant alone is unsafe and may worsen.
Incorrect. Delay risks catastrophe.

items.q: Delusional disorder differs from schizophrenia most by what?
o: Function preserved outside delusions, hallucinations not prominent
items.exp: Patients work and relate normally apart from delusional ramifications; prominent hallucinations, disorganisation and negative symptoms point instead to schizophrenia.
r: Incorrect. Delusions may be non bizarre (plausible themes).
Correct. Preserved function, quiet other domains.
Incorrect. Onset is often middle age.
Incorrect. Negative dominance is schizophrenia deficit pattern.
items.kp: Normal life wrapped around one fixed belief.

items.q: Schizophreniform disorder is diagnosed when schizophrenia like illness lasts how long?
items.exp: One to six months of schizophrenia picture without yet meeting six month schizophrenia duration is schizophreniform; many later reclassify as schizophrenia if course extends.
r: Incorrect. Under month is brief psychotic.
Correct. One to six months schizophreniform.
Incorrect. Two years exceeds schizophrenia threshold already.
Incorrect. Duration defines category, not lifetime guarantee.
items.kp: Too long for brief, too short for schizophrenia: schizophreniform.

items.q: Erotomanic delusion (de Clerambault) consists of belief that what?
o: Another person, often higher status, is in love with the patient
items.exp: Erotomania fixes on a usually unattainable love object, interpreting neutral acts as secret signals, with stalking risk. Jealousy, infestation and broadcasting belong to other phenomena.
r: Incorrect. That is jealous type.
Correct. Beloved higher status admirer is erotomania.
Incorrect. Infestation is somatic Ekbom.
Incorrect. Broadcasting is first rank symptom.

items.q: First psychosis at age 55 with visual hallucinations and fluctuating confusion first requires what?
o: Medical and delirium workup before primary psychosis label
items.exp: Late onset, visual modality and fluctuation are red flags for delirium, dementia, Parkinson spectrum, substances and medical disease; investigation precedes primary psychotic disorder diagnosis.
r: Incorrect. Age and signs argue secondary cause.
Correct. Exclude medical causes first.
Incorrect. Depot commits before diagnosis known.
Incorrect. Therapy does not investigate confusion.
items.kp: Old, visual and fluctuating: work up the body.

items.q: Shared psychotic disorder (folie a deux) is characterised by what?
o: Delusion transmitted from dominant ill person to close dependent associate, improving on separation
items.exp: Induced delusional disorder develops in close associate of a primarily psychotic dominant person and often remits when separated, while treating the inducer. It is now classified under delusional disorders spectrum.
r: Incorrect. Coincidence is not induction.
Correct. Transmitted delusion remitting on separation.
Incorrect. Concordance is genetic epidemiology.
Incorrect. Cultural beliefs shared widely are not folie a deux.
